# Architecture Recommendation

Based on the constraints, I recommend a **self-hosted open-source stack** using Docker containers orchestrated with Docker Compose (or Kubernetes if the team has that experience), deployed on a cost-effective cloud provider like AWS EC2 free tier or a $5-10/month VPS. This approach keeps infrastructure costs minimal while using free tools (Docker, open-source databases like PostgreSQL, and monitoring solutions like Prometheus), staying well under the $500 budget. Pair this with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) for maintainability and document the deployment process to ensure the team can easily manage and update the system.
